# CheckNumber Phone Number Checker API
> Official integration context generated from the checked API expansion manifest.

## Canonical resources
- [phoneCheck](https://docs.checknumber.ai/phone-number-validation)
- [active_check](https://docs.checknumber.ai/number-active-check)
- [high_value_users](https://docs.checknumber.ai/high-value-users-checker)

## Contract facts
- API base URL: https://api.checknumber.ai
- Authentication: `X-API-Key` request header
- API key environment variable: `CHECKNUMBER_API_KEY`
- Processing mode: async_bulk
- Current prices are not embedded; use the official pricing page.

## Products
- `phoneCheck`: Validity Checker · input `phone` · fields: number, activated
- `active_check`: Activity Checker · input `phone` · fields: number, activated
- `high_value_users`: High-Value Checker · input `phone` · fields: Mobile Number, Result

## Safety
- Process only identifiers you are authorized to verify.
- Do not expose API keys in browser code or commit secrets.
- An undetermined result is not a confirmed negative.

Last reviewed: 2026-08-18.
